app.name: Sidekey
hk.ctrlT: Ctrl + T opens a new tab in browsers. If you assign it, it will stop working there.
hk.ctrlShiftT: Ctrl + Shift + T reopens a closed tab in browsers — it will stop working there.
hk.ctrlLetter: Ctrl + letter shortcuts are often used by browsers and programs (copy, save, tabs). A shortcut with Alt is safer, for example Ctrl + Alt + T.
hk.altKey: Alt + key is used by Windows and programs (menus, switching windows). Better add Ctrl.
hk.invalid: The shortcut must include Ctrl or Alt and one more key.
hk.taken: {0} is already assigned to {1}. Choose another shortcut.
hk.busy: Could not assign {0}: it is already used by Windows or another program. Choose another one.

launch.uacCancelled: “{0}”: launch cancelled — the administrator prompt was not confirmed.

welcome.text:
Welcome!

• Open and hide the panel with {0}. You can change it in Settings (the gear icon at the top of the panel).
• The program runs in the background — its icon is in the notification area next to the clock. Closing the panel does not exit the program; to exit, right-click the icon → “Exit”.
• Only the time spent in the active program is counted. All data is stored only on this computer.

To show the weather, choose your city. Do it now?
stats.clearAsk: Delete all collected time statistics? This cannot be undone.
time.privacy: Only the name of the active program and the time spent in it are recorded. Keystrokes, window text and websites are not recorded. Data is stored only on this computer.
time.noData: No data for this period yet.
time.now.idle: No activity for more than {0} min — time is not counted.
time.now.locked: The computer is locked — time is not counted.
time.now.paused: Tracking is paused — time is not counted.
notes.empty: No notes yet. Click “+ New note”.
notes.deleteAsk: Delete the note “{0}”? It cannot be restored.
lp.hint: A button opens all programs and websites in its set. If a program needs administrator rights, Windows will show its own prompt.
lp.empty: No buttons yet. Click “+ New button” and add programs and websites to it.
lp.deleteAsk: Delete the button “{0}”? The programs themselves are not deleted.
